description: This file defines an interface class IWebAudioPlayerService for managing web audio playback, including methods for creating, controlling, and querying audio players within the Rialto server service component.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerService
classes.description: An interface class providing virtual methods for web audio player management, including creation, control, and information retrieval functions.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new web audio player with specified parameters and associates it with a client.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys an existing web audio player identified by handle.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the specified web audio player.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback of the specified web audio player.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets the end-of-stream marker for the specified web audio player.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available buffer frames and shared memory info for the specified player.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer delay in frames for the specified player.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer of the specified player.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for the specified player.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level of the specified player.
